message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.** The City of Atlanta’s local government (the city council) does not take noise complaints directly, but it has a system in place for residents to report them to the appropriate agency—usually the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the **Department of Public Safety**. Below is a quick guide on how to do it, plus the relevant legal framework and contact details. --- ## 1. How to File a Noise Complaint | Method | What to Do | Where to Go | |--------|------------|-------------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal.
• Select “Noise” or “Code Enforcement.”
• Fill out the form with details (date, time, location, description).
• Submit. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **Phone** | • Call the 311 hotline (free from any phone).
• Tell the operator you want to file a noise complaint.
• Provide the same details as above. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **In‑person** | • Go to the nearest police precinct or the City of Atlanta Police Department’s main office.
• Speak with an officer or a public safety representative.
• Provide details and fill out a written complaint if requested. | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 (Police HQ) | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta Police Department.
• Include your name, address, phone number, and a detailed description. | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | > **Tip:** If you’re dealing with a recurring issue (e.g., a neighbor’s loud party every weekend), it’s helpful to keep a log of dates, times, and any witnesses. This makes it easier for the police to investigate. --- ## 2. Legal Basis | Category | Law / Ordinance | Key Points | |----------|-----------------|------------| | **Noise Ordinance** | *City of Atlanta Noise Ordinance* (Chapter 10, Article 1 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) | • Prohibits excessive noise that disturbs the peace.
• Defines “excessive noise” and sets permissible decibel limits.
• Establishes penalties (fines, citations). | | **General Code Enforcement** | *Atlanta Municipal Code – Chapter 10, Article 2* | • Covers violations of city ordinances, including noise.
• Provides the process for filing complaints and issuing citations. | > **Where to find the text:** > • Atlanta Municipal Code (online): https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code > • Noise Ordinance PDF: https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2024-01/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf --- ## 3. Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Email | Address | |--------|-------|-------|---------| | **City of Atlanta Police Department** | 404‑656‑4000 (311) | police@atlantaga.gov | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | **City of Atlanta Department of Public Safety** | 404‑656‑4000 (311) | publicsafety@atlantaga.gov | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | **City of Atlanta 311 Service** | 404‑656‑4000 | 311@atlantaga.gov | 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309 | > **Note:** The 311 line is free from any phone and is the quickest way to get routed to the correct department. --- ## 4. Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need a police report?** | Not initially. You can file a complaint online or by phone. If the police investigate, they may issue a citation. | | **What if the noise is from a commercial establishment?** | The same process applies. The police will coordinate with the City’s Code Enforcement division. | | **Can I file a complaint anonymously?** | The police prefer a contact name and phone number for follow‑up, but you can request anonymity. | | **What if the noise continues after a citation?** | The police can issue a second citation or refer the matter to the City’s Code Enforcement for further action. | --- ### Bottom Line - **Yes, you can report noise complaints in Atlanta.** - Use the 311 portal, phone line, or visit the police department. - The complaint will be forwarded to the City of Atlanta Police Department or the Department of Public Safety, which will investigate and enforce the Noise Ordinance. If you need more specific legal information or want to see the exact text of the noise ordinance, let me know and I can pull up the relevant categories using the `get_law_categories` function.
